decisions: Exact entitlement links only; context links never establish a paid feature.
Generated prediction export is separate from exporting user ratings or account data; taste-match values are not predicted own scores.

Chip labels prefer a normal offer within the same documented entitlement group when available among the eligible observations. Prices never determine the representative label; exact gift/store observations remain in details.
Store prices and conditional eligibility do not prove checkout; the paid gate must be documented separately.
Trial-only, obsolete conflicting price observations and configuration-only prices are excluded; another qualified offer may support the same capability.
Annict, Criticker, SIMKL and MyEpisodes functional supporter gates are eligible; human recognition and supporter feeds are not.
Stremio household controls are eligible; downloaded media, subtitles, skipping and player/server operations are not.
CineTrak regional ad-removal and Filmweb/Filmarks ad exceptions remain qualified per variant.
Source statuses are retained in details; display Have is never derived from a narrow unrelated template. Capacity and cosmetic template matches are conservatively Not checked.
Ownership is adjacent consumer scope and labeled separately; institutional extra managers and SSO remain excluded.
